mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,id,task_id,step_id,attempt_id,ordinal,slot,provider_id,effect_intent_id,tool,plugin_version,plugin_digest,installation_epoch,input_snapshot,input_digest,state,output_snapshot,output_digest,projection_version,updated_at,record_version,todo_expected_revision,todo_applied_revision,todo_committed_attempt_id,todo_committed_fence,todo_event_seq,todo_committed_at FROM invocation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} AND step_id=#{step} AND slot=#{slot} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*)+1 FROM user_question WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task}
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET tools_used=tools_used+1,waiting_question_id=#{request} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{task}
UPDATE tenant_budget SET tool_used=tool_used+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant}
UPDATE invocation SET state='WAITING_USER' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{invocation} AND state='PENDING'
